mechanism: Foscarnet causes significant electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) that may impair raloxifene efficacy and increase risk of QT prolongation; both drugs have potential for mineral metabolism disturbances.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes, calcium, and magnesium regularly; consider ECG monitoring; ensure adequate supplementation of depleted minerals; assess whether raloxifene therapy should continue during foscarnet treatment.
